text:
No hiring option can be put forward from this run: the £400k/year salary limit was not checked.

- All four options lacked an annual-salary-spend value, so the analysis treated them as leaving salary spend unchanged. This makes the budget comparison uninformative.
- The result is fragile and entirely provisional: the key delivery-capacity and onboarding inputs are Olumi estimates, while the source for salary-spend effects is not recorded.
- The goal’s direction was also assumed to mean “more platform delivery is better”, rather than stated by you.

The useful next reasoning step is to specify the annual salary spend for each staffing option in £/year, including current staffing.
